So, I pulled off to the side of the highway and we proceeded to sit there and enjoy our near-hysterical and unstoppable giggles.

Which is when someone knocked on the driver's side window.

That someone was a police officer and he wanted to know if we were alright - as stopping on the side of the highway is illegal unless it's an emergency. At least I'm pretty sure that's what he wanted, we were giggling too hard to really pay him much attention and weren't even remotely concerned with his badge and gun. My buddy piped up, "We can't stop laughing," through a strained voice and turned the volume up on the radio so that the officer could hear the song.

He listened for a moment with us and said, "You boys are too fucked up to drive. Get off the roads and don't let me see you out here again, or I'm taking you to jail." He then hopped back in his car and sat behind us while we continued our giggle fit until well after the song was over. We finally drove forward, picked up speed, and merged into the travel lane and the officer drove by us a few seconds later. We pulled off the next exit and had a merry time driving across MA on the regular access roads.

And that's my story about the first time I heard this song.
